# PartyCard

A dinner party at a glance: who is in it, how it is scoring, what it has cooked lately.

`NomNom.PartyCard` · Content

## Use

```jsx
<NomNom.PartyCard name="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="NomNom.PartyCard" name="…"></x-import>
```

## Notes

A dinner party at a glance. 'mine' shows its score; 'discover' offers the join action.
